summary: Full frontend E2E of Village Legends. Covered login validation, hero select (10 heroes w/ detail switching), main menu, world map (ch1 unlocked, ch2-10 locked), chapter screen (level gating 1-1 vs 1-2), battle (attack, defend, potion menu toggle, skill enabled with MP, escape succeeds, victory flow), progression (coins +29 after 1-1 win, 1-2 unlocked), shop (buy HP potion: coins -50, count +1; disabled when poor), inventory, quests, character, settings toggles persist to localStorage, reload persistence (resumes at menu, not login), and reset save (returns to login, clears localStorage key). All critical flows work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: BattleScreen.jsx line 202-204 mutates context profile.consumables inside useEffect without state update - direct mutation of state object; works here because of localStorage persistence sync, but is a React anti-pattern and could cause stale UI in other screens until next setProfile. Consider calling a context method to sync consumables.
GameContext.applyXp mutates `p` parameter in place inside setProfile updater (OK since caller creates fresh next) but mixes mutation + immutable patterns; keep style consistent.

claimQuest reward includes `r.coins` branch that reassigns next.stats to spread but doesn't actually change stats.coinsEarned (dead line next.stats = {...next.stats, coinsEarned: next.stats.coinsEarned}).
Loot drop (40% for normal) is RNG so can't be deterministically tested; consider seeding or test hook.
No data-testid on hero detail panel to assert which hero's details are shown; relied on visible 'Confirm <name>' text.
test_credentials: None required - local username. Used 'Tester'. localStorage key: village_legends_save_v1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is client-side state machine with single '/' route; 'screen' controlled by GameContext. Hero IDs are aiden/luna/ronan/mira/kael/bruno/sylvie/darius/elian/riven (NOT 'arin' as spec implied). Starting profile: 500 coins, 3 HP + 2 MP potions, level 1. Combat is turn-based with ~0.3-0.5s animation timers (wait ~900-1100ms per attack cycle). Battle attack chain: attack -> 260ms damage -> 450ms -> enemyTurn 300ms -> 450ms. Escape has RNG; may need multiple attempts. Boss levels (level 5 of each chapter) disable escape and advance progress.unlockedChapter on defeat. For deterministic battle tests, consider mocking Math.random. All verified data-testid attributes present and functional.
